versions.subject: Merge PR #4794 from @ruppde - Potential Exploitation of CVE-2024-3094
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    ParentImage|endswith: '/sshd'
    CommandLine|startswith:
        - 'bash -c'
        - 'sh -c'
    User: 'root'
selection_2:
    ParentImage|endswith: '/sshd'
    Image|endswith: '/sshd'
    User: 'sshd'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (ParentImage="*/sshd" CommandLine IN ("bash -c*", "sh -c*") User="root") OR (ParentImage="*/sshd" Image="*/sshd" User="sshd")
